name: optimize_go_string_concat_loop
description: String += in a loop -> strings.Builder; budget calibrated in-container (naive ~2.5s at n=40k vs ~0.001s, budget 1.2s); wrong-output broken drops the trailing newline
prompts: JoinLines(lines []string) in report.go concatenates every line with `out += line + "\n"` - each += copies the whole accumulated string, making the function O(n^2) in total characters and far too slow for large reports. Rewrite it using strings.Builder (WriteString / WriteByte), returning EXACTLY the same string: every line terminated by a newline, including the last one, and the empty slice giving the empty string. Keep the package name, function name, and signature.
